subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals - Acuity Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Josh Carter <josh.carter@acuityhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals - Acuity Health

Hi Josh / Emily —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and the next steps we agreed on. Please correct me if I missed anything.

Key pain points you called out:
- Lack of end-to-end observability for LLM regressions: hard to triage when quality drops after a model/version change.
- No golden prompt set to proactively detect regressions across core intents (clinical summarization, triage, billing).
- Limited tracing hooks to connect app-level request IDs to token-level outputs (makes RCA slow).
- Current stack: internal microservices (Node/Python), Redis cache for prompts, Postgres for user metadata, and inference in-house on mixed GPU fleet (NVIDIA A100 + some older V100s).

Success criteria for initial eval/pilot:
1) Repro detectability: We want alerts when median/90th p95 metric on golden prompt set degrades by >5% relative to baseline.
2) Traceability: ability to trace a user request -> model output tokens -> prompt/temperature context in logs.
3) Dashboarding: per-route latency, per-model quality score over time (with ability to filter by region/model variant).
4) Low-friction pilot: 1 week of live traffic shadowing + 2 weeks of canary with rollback guardrails.

Specific observability + eval asks you requested:
- Pre-built dashboard templates: model health, token-cost drilldowns, regression timeline.
- Tracing hooks: example instrumentation for request_id propagation and sampling configs.
- Golden prompt sets: CSV with canonical prompts for clinical summary, triage, billing — would like to see an example template we can populate.
- Regression alerts: support for threshold alerts + anomaly detection on metric deltas.
- Rollout guardrails: automatic fallback to a stable model variant if error rate/latency breaches thresholds during rollout.

Action items / next steps (ownership + target dates):
- Redwood: share discovery deck, golden-prompts template, and meeting recording — sent (attachments). (Marissa) — by EOD 6/15.
- Acuity: confirm 3-4 golden prompts per intent and identify pilot route(s) (clinical-summarization + triage). (Josh / Emily) — by 6/18.
- Acuity: confirm procurement timeline and SOC 2 requirements; loop in procurement contact. (Josh) — by 6/19.
- Redwood: provision eval project and provide short instructions for tracing instrumention (sample middleware). (Marissa / Rishi) — target 6/22 for access.

Proposed pilot cadence:
- Week 1 (shadow): Redwood collects telemetry and runs golden-prompt evals on mirrored traffic.
- Week 2 (canary): 10% of traffic to Redwood with automatic rollback guardrails and regression alerts enabled.
- Week 3 (scale): expand to 50% after meeting success criteria.

Attachments referenced:
- discovery-deck-acuity.pdf (overview + dashboard mockups)
- golden-prompts-template.csv (CSV template for prompts and expected outputs)
- meeting_recording_20260615.mp4 (recording)

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: forwarded from call notes (internal): engineer asks to confirm whether you require token-level logs retained for >30 days or longer — please advise so we can include retention in the SOW.

From: Josh Carter <josh.carter@acuityhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acuityhealth.com>, procurement@acuityhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 17:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals - Acuity Health

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Priority intents: Clinical summarization (highest), Triage (medium), and Billing categorization (nice-to-have). We'll aim to send 4 representative prompts per intent by end of week.
2) Retention: we'll need token-level logs for 90 days for internal audit. Can you confirm Redwood's support for that and whether there's a cost delta?
3) SOC2: our security team wants a copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report and an estimated turnaround for any SSO/KMS integrations.
4) Procurement timeline: we are targeting an evaluation PO within 3 weeks; I've cc'd procurement to help with paperwork.

We can do the 6/22 access target. If you can send over step-by-step instrumentation snippets (Node + Python), that will speed things up.

Also — could you include sample dashboard screenshots (latency + quality) so our product folks have a look?

Appreciate it,
Josh
Director of Product, Acuity Health
josh.carter@acuityhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Josh Carter <josh.carter@acuityhealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals - Acuity Health

Josh — thanks for the quick turnaround. Quick replies inline: 

- Retention: Redwood supports configurable token-level log retention up to 365 days. For 90 days, we'll include that in the eval project; I'll flag any incremental storage costs in the SOW.
- SOC2: attaching SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx with the list your security team asked for — I'll also include a copy of our SOC 2 Type II (pending final upload from security, should have it by EOD 6/17).
- Instrumentation: see attached discovery-deck-acuity.pdf for screenshot mocks and the golden-prompts-template.csv. Rishi will send thin Node + Python middleware examples for propagating request_id and sampling strategies.

Proposed dates:
- 6/22: Eval access + instrumentation guide.
- 6/23-6/29: Shadow week (we will populate dashboards and run golden prompt baseline).
- 6/30: Canary start at 10% if baseline checks pass.

I'll draft an eval SOW and share with procurement; can you confirm the internal PO owner so we route correctly?

Thanks — looping Rishi to own the instrumentation deliverables.

Best,
Marissa
(Account Executive)

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Discovery Recap: Observability & Evals - Acuity Health (internal)

Marissa — quick internal note on deliverables I committed to: 

- I'll produce Node/Express middleware snippet and Python/Flask example by EOD 6/18 for request_id propagation + sampling.
- I'll create the initial golden-prompts CSV with 3 canonical prompts per intent (we'll use placeholders for PII).
- I'll stand up the dashboard templates (Model Health, Token Cost, Regression Timeline) and share Drive link by 6/21.
- I'll also draft rollback guardrail rules (latency > 2s p95 OR quality drop > 5% on golden set triggers automatic fallback).

I'll schedule a short sync with you on 6/18 to hand off the artifacts to Acuity.

—Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
